chapterTitle: Chapter 16 Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
title: Problem 16-19

pages.text: PROBLEM 16-19 Refer to Table 6.3 for a quantitative idea of the stability of a benzyl radical. How much more stable (in kJ/mol) is the benzyl radical than a primary alkyl radical? How does a benzyl radical compare in stability to an allyl radical?
